system.description:
A character with this power instinctively understands what one other person in a conversation (living or undead) wants to hear. If he can find a way to phrase what he wants so that it sounds like what that person wants to hear, this helps him get his point across, ingratiate himself, or accumulate favors. Unlike Telepathy, the subject need not be actively thinking about what she wants to hear.

System: The character must spend at least a minute speaking with the subject, and the player must make a successful Perception + Empathy roll (difficulty 6). Reliance on mechanics should only be used as a last resort, since the very nature of this power is social and should rarely be dictated by dice instead of roleplaying.

MET System: The character must spend at least a minute speaking with the subject and the player must make a Mental Challenge against the subject. If successful, both players should decide how to deal with the actual conversation from that point, ideally roleplaying it out with the subject's player reacting favorably. If the players decide to resort to mechanics instead, the character with the power initiates a Social Challenge against the subject, winning on ties.

This is a rare power known only to a handful of elder Toreador who have mastered Auspex beyond Level Five.
